title: A Tour of the Twelve Canonical Sections
excerpt: Hero, intro, features, gallery and friends - the reusable vocabulary this consumer and the WordPress plugin share.

data.heading: One vocabulary, both sides of the boundary
data.body: Hero, intro, rich_text, image_text, features, statistics, testimonials, gallery, cta, faq, logo_grid, and form_embed are the twelve canonical section types. Git content authors them by hand; the WordPress companion plugin produces the same names from ACF layouts.

data.heading: Intro leads a story
data.body: A short eyebrow, a heading, and a paragraph - often with an image beside it. It sets the scene without stealing the headline.

data.heading: Do sections fall back to HTML?

items.question: What if a post has no sections?
items.answer: The post page falls back to the raw HTML stored in the content field, which is exactly what a plain WordPress post provides.

items.question: What if a section type is unknown?
items.answer: PostSections logs a build warning and skips it instead of failing the whole page.
